_note: Game configuration and the specials requested by world content.

specials.behaviour: Called when the Heart Lantern is rekindled (the dialogue also sets flags heart_lantern_lit and lanterns_rekindled). Play the valley-wide relight moment: every prop whose art is 'prop_spirit_lantern_dark' on every map is drawn as 'prop_spirit_lantern' from now on and gets a warm light (#ffd27a, radius 3.5 x scale, intensity 0.9, offset [0, 1.6 x scale], flicker), persisted via the lanterns_rekindled flag so it survives save/load and map changes. Optional polish: switch Lanternvale's windmill to a turning animation and add fireflies to every map.
